column3: “A rooster of loins” is rendered “The strutting cock,” and “a band of soldiers with him” as “when his army is with him.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
NASB adds “evil” and “put your … on”; the Hebrew says “if you have plotted, hand to mouth.”
Close to the Hebrew; The single Hebrew verb “squeezing” is rendered “churning,” “pressing,” and “churning,” and NASB adds “So.”
